description: Convert a JSON Schema document into TypeScript interfaces/types. Unlike json_to_typescript (which infers types from an example data payload), this reads the schema's declared type/enum/required keywords directly, so optional vs. required fields and enum/union types come through accurately. Understands local $ref into $defs/definitions, items for arrays, additionalProperties, and renders description as a JSDoc comment.

root_name.description: Name for the root generated interface/type

schema.description: The JSON Schema document, as a JSON string

name: json_schema_to_typescript
